author: Ismail Hammoudeh
acknowledgement: Developed with extensive use of ChatGPT.

provenance.method: PITC: diameter-normalized positional RMS over the 100 equal-area angle shapes; independent 40-shape holdout.

metric: RMS Euclidean distance divided by each triangle diameter; ranking uses training shapes only.
coverage: All 72,807 snapshot records visited through the PITC coordinate cache; rankings among the 70,853 complete finite training fingerprints. Unsupported and singular records are excluded, not replaced with zero.
identity_note: At p=2 both families equal X(2) exactly. Numerical proximity elsewhere does not assert an ETC identity or transfer attractivity.
formula_attribution: Clark Kimberling, Encyclopedia of Triangle Centers; selected formulas from the supplied Unlicense Triangle Center Tools snapshot. Research rankings by Ismail Hammoudeh with extensive use of ChatGPT.

attractivity.method: Forward automatic differentiation of algebraic cyclic barycentrics; all three vertex Jacobians. Independent finite motions check negative responses. Positive samples do not prove universal attractivity.
attractivity.positive_warning: No sampled failure does not prove universal attractivity. ETC rules are independent of p; status belongs to the rule, not to its matching power.
